label: normal
title: Legit bank fraud alert (hard negative: bank + card + account talk, never asks for codes)

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Rachel from the fraud department at First Valley Bank. Is this Robert Chen?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thanks, Robert. We noticed an unusual charge on your debit card and wanted to check with you. Did you make a purchase at an electronics store in Ohio this morning?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: No, I've been home all day. I didn't buy anything.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Okay, thank you. I've blocked that charge, and we'll send you a new card in the mail within five to seven days.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Oh good. Do you need anything from me?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, nothing at all. And just so you know, we will never ask you for your PIN, your password, or a code we text you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you want to double check this call, you can hang up and dial the number on the back of your card. Anyone there can see this note on your account.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I appreciate that. Thank you for catching it.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You're welcome, Robert. Have a good rest of your day.
